result.response:
IIT Madras leads India's computer science research funding with ₹187.20 Cr across 71 active researchers, followed by IIT Bombay at ₹171.50 Cr across 66 researchers. [cite:nrg-researchers:0]

The data shows two premier institutions commanding a combined ₹358.70 Cr in verified research funding, with IIT Madras holding a marginal advantage in both researcher count and aggregate allocation. These figures reflect deterministic records from researcher funding databases and institutional metadata. [cite:nrg-institutions:0]

For Tier 3 partners, institutional-level aggregates enable strategic benchmarking and collaboration opportunity identification while maintaining researcher privacy. Anonymized capability mapping allows assessment of research capacity without exposing personal identifiers or individual contact details.

The evidence covers only the top 2 ranked institutions by aggregate funding—broader landscape analysis requires higher-tier access. All figures are derived from verified runtime database records; funding allocation methodologies may vary across institutions.
